observed_gap: Notion DelegationRequest and DelegationContext carry no delegated tool/capability policy.
Notion server child runtime exposes a fixed catalog containing write_file, edit_file and run_shell.
Qwen coding subagent defaults terminal=true and files=true; files=true enables read and mutating file tools together.

Therefore a restricted/read-only parent capability set cannot be preserved by the current neutral delegation envelope, and a future Qwen adapter cannot safely approximate read-only with the current boolean files switch.

candidate_contract.delegation_envelope: carry an explicit immutable provider-neutral tool capability allowlist or equivalent policy
candidate_contract.missing_policy: fail closed for delegated execution; never widen to provider defaults

candidate_contract.no_implicit_escalation: child capabilities must be a subset of the parent/delegation policy unless an explicit higher-trust policy is separately authorized
